examples.title: Basic video player
examples.description: Play, pause, and seek from the media controls. Only https, http, and blob sources load.

examples.title: Comment markers and chapters
examples.description: Numbered markers on the seek track jump to each comment, the chapters list the walkthrough's sections, and the bound position feeds a comment action at the end of the controls row.
examples.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { Button, VideoPlayer } from '@lostgradient/cinder';

  let currentTime = $state(19);

  const markers = [
    { time: 8, badge: '1', label: 'Comment 1 at 0:08' },
    { time: 19, badge: '2', label: 'Comment 2 at 0:19' },
    { time: 33, badge: '3', label: 'Comment 3 at 0:33' },
  ];

  const chapters = [
    { time: 0, title: 'Open board' },
    { time: 12, title: 'Add card' },
    { time: 30, title: 'Move card' },
  ];

  function clock(seconds: number): string {
    const whole = Math.floor(seconds);
    return `${Math.floor(whole / 60)}:${String(whole % 60).padStart(2, '0')}`;
  }
</script>

<VideoPlayer
  src="https://example.com/media/walkthrough.mp4"
  label="Walkthrough recording"
  {markers}
  {chapters}
  bind:currentTime
>
  {#snippet actions({ currentTime: position })}
    <Button size="sm">Comment at {clock(position)}</Button>
  {/snippet}
</VideoPlayer>

examples.title: Unavailable source
examples.description: A source whose scheme is not https, http, or blob never loads and renders the unavailable controls.
examples.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { VideoPlayer } from '@lostgradient/cinder';
</script>

<VideoPlayer src="data:text/html,unsupported" label="Blocked source" />
